name: GROKD
fix_description: In function 0xd2beb00a, func_05A6 directly writes to a storage array without any msg.sender check. Any caller can overwrite contract configuration data. Add onlyOwner modifier (call func_1C0A like other admin functions do).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward lack-of-access-control exploit: the attacker simply acquires LP, deposits it, calls an unrestricted updatePool to set an absurd rewardPerBlock, advances blocks, and claims rewards. It involves only a few obvious steps and minimal protocol-specific reasoning, so a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
